name: First Kick VR Soccer
summary:
Step onto the pitch and experience the pressure of every shot in Firstkick VR Soccer, the most immersive VR soccer game built for Meta Quest and Meta Quest 3.

Choose how you want to play:

Shootout Mode puts you behind the ball in this fast-paced VR soccer simulator. Pick your target, line up the shot, and try to beat the goalkeeper. Improve your aim, timing, and finishing as you chase cleaner, more accurate strikes.
